results.title: Mobile phone apps for family caregivers: A scoping review and qualitative content analysis - PMC
results.snippet: Our objectives were to identify the apps currently available to support family caregivers and to analyze the app functions and evaluation claims. This scoping review was conducted across the iOS, Android, and Windows Phone app stores in three steps: (1) electronic app search; (2) iterative inclusion and exclusion criteria development; (3) mixed-method analysis of app characteristics and evaluation claims.
